items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: This girl... Now I met her when she was a beautiful girl.

ctx.x: Anyway, he became a warrant officer, and... Well, she did, and she wrote about him in Lady Sings The Blues. Well, she has so many suits about her in that book that, I mean, I didn't bother. I said, "Look, John, she's inferring that I didn't write this song." He said, "Well, look, they got so many suits..."
This girl... Now I met her when she was a beautiful girl.
